title: Vacuum - Flow Measurement
description: Measure air volume flow in vacuum. Convert between standard volume flow (scfm/nl/s) and actual volume flow (acfm/al/s) using pressure and temperature.

components.content:
# Vacuum - Flow Measurement Calculator

Convert standard volume flow to actual volume flow in vacuum conditions.

Use the formula:

**qa = qs (29.92 / p) ((t + 460) / 520)**

Where:
- **qa** = actual volume flow (acfm)
- **qs** = standard volume flow (scfm)
- **p** = actual pressure (in Hg absolute)
- **t** = temperature (°F)
